newsitem.title: USA: Horizon to be acquired by Compass.
newsitem.headline: Horizon to be acquired by Compass.

text.p: Horizon Bancorp Inc said Thursday it agreed to by acquired by Compass Bancshares Inc.
Compass will exchange 888,889 shares of its common stock for all of the 1.4 million shares of outstanding common stock and options of Horizon, Horizon said.
Assuming all options are exercised, each Horizon shareholder will receive 0.5629 shares of Compass Bancshares common stock for each share of Horizon common stock, Horizon said.
The acquisition will add $143 million in assets and $129 million in deposits to Compass in Texas, the companies said.

"We've made no secret of wanting to be in Austin because of its strong, diversified and growing economy," said Compass Chairman D. Paul Jones Jr. "The acquisition will add value to our franchise and allow us to compete in another important Texas market."
The transaction is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to be finalized in the first quarter of 1997, the companies said.
